metadata.annotation_policy: first geometric surface including opaque glass; geometric interpolated view normals; camera z-depth by default; no per-pixel instance IDs

flow.axes: positive x right, positive y down
flow.direction: forward; source timestep t to target t+1, same camera index
flow.optical_flow_units: pixels per captured interval; not pixels per second
flow.precision: float32 raster attachments; no color conversion or tonemapping
flow.surface: first geometric surface including opaque glass; excludes reflection/refraction and shading motion
flow.terminal: last timestep has zero vectors and both masks zero
flow.valid: source surface retains vertex correspondence and target lies between near/far planes; off-screen targets remain valid
flow.visible: valid target lies in image and passes target surface depth test

metadata.gi_human_motion_policy: planned motion candidates omitted from static indirect transport; live direct shadows retained
